summary: Verified SQL migration ordering fix for /app/backend/migrations/001_initial.sql against local Postgres 15. All 7 requested checks passed: (1) organization_members table (line 70) is created BEFORE private.is_org_member() function (line 248); (2) migration runs end-to-end on a fresh DB with exit code 0 and zero ERROR lines; (3) all 9 expected tables exist with rowsecurity=t; (4) 2nd run is idempotent — exit 0 and no ERROR lines (only NOTICE 'skipping' lines); (5) org_members_insert policy WITH CHECK contains ONLY has_org_role check, no user_id=auth.uid() self-insert clause; (6) create_organization_with_owner RPC has revoke from public, revoke from anon, grant to authenticated (lines 426-428); (7) frontend testing skipped per request (testing_type=backend only).

If future changes touch RLS or private schema helpers, re-run: dropdb migration_verify && createdb migration_verify, seed auth stub, then psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f 001_initial.sql. rca of the issue: Original bug: private.is_org_member() defined LANGUAGE sql was created BEFORE public.organization_members table. Postgres validates LANGUAGE sql function bodies at CREATE time (unlike plpgsql), so parser resolved public.organization_members and threw 42P01. Fix: move the entire private helpers block to Section 6, after Section 4 business tables. Verified by grep + fresh-DB apply.
